About us

Perfume that feels like a garden at sunrise.

ÉLÈNE is built on one idea: a scent should feel like a place you want to return to.

Each eau de parfum is composed from natural florals, fruits, woods and resins. It opens fresh and bright, then settles into a soft base that stays close to the skin all day. Every bottle is sculpted in clear glass with a marble-white cap and a gold collar.

  • Natural ingredients

    Peony, rose, jasmine, lavender and vanilla.

  • Long lasting

    A soft base of musk, amber and wood.

  • Elegant & unique

    A sculpted 50 ml bottle for every day.
